run_f_gold: run f_gold to find K maximum non-overlapping contiguous sub-array sums using Kadane algorithm
test_f_gold: test f_gold with an array, k value, and n to print K max sub-array sums
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return results as a list instead of printing sub-array sums
review_f_gold: review f_gold Kadane algorithm variant that finds K non-overlapping maximum sum sub-arrays
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which iteratively finds K max contiguous sub-arrays by zeroing used elements
